description: SIGMA is a team passionate about science, technology, and space exploration. We combine creativity, engineering, and teamwork to design innovative space missions and solve real-world challenges.
summary: Our project was a space mission game. This project shows what the life of an astronaut is like from waking up until arriving at a mission. This project, besides being simple, It's an educational and quite entertaining game; it's important that people don't just see space missions as launching a rocket, but also The preparation We hope you enjoy playing these.
details:
Artemis: The Astronaut's Journey is an educational game built in Godot Engine that lets players live NASA's Artemis II mission from the inside, from the morning the crew assignment arrives to splashdown in the Pacific.

The player wakes up at home, receives an internal email confirming their selection, and rides the Astrovan to Kennedy Space Center. There they complete astronaut training, tour the facilities and help prepare the SLS rocket and the Orion spacecraft in the Vehicle Assembly Building: distributing power, installing life-support filters, replacing damaged heat-shield sections and configuring radio antennas. They then run the countdown from Mission Control, pack food supplies, launch from Pad 39B, fly a free-return trajectory around the far side of the Moon and return safely to Earth.

Artemis II flew in April 2026 as humanity's first crewed lunar voyage in more than 50 years. Our game turns that real mission profile (four crew, about ten days, SLS Block 1 and Orion) into a playable story, so players learn the engineering and physics behind the return to the Moon by doing it themselves.
